id: title:estefaniarabadan:rank claim candidates narrow to avoid sort spill

review.posthog_relevance: Database query optimization for candidate selection, reducing memory and CPU usage by narrowing the candidate set before ranking, while retaining full-row candidates in a separate CTE.
review.reason: The observed changes demonstrate a substantive, bounded improvement in database query performance. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H3 show the removal of metadata and other columns from the candidate SQL, retaining only id and created_at, while P1.F1.H4 retains full-row candidates in a separate CTE. review.uncertainty: The exact performance gain and the specific database backend compatibility are not demonstrated; the benefit relies on the assumption that the query planner and execution environment will benefit from this restructuring, which is not independently verified. No adoption or incident avoidance is observed.
